name: ListResourceInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource group is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters instances by billing method. Valid values:

- PrePaid: subscription.

- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
过滤机器付费类型，取值如下：
- PrePaid：预付费。
- PostPaid：后付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 专属资源组机器列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to return on each page. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的机器数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filter by instance ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412129.html
parameters.help_zh: 按实例ID过滤。如何获取实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412129.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the instance
parameters.name: instance_ip

parameters.help_en: A keyword for the search. You can search by instance ID or IP address
parameters.help_zh: 关键字搜索。支持按机器ID或IP进行搜索
parameters.name: filter
